answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a staked identity registry with cluster slashing. To register an agent you lock a native-token bond; attestations count per identity but are capped per controlling key. At dawn each epoch, graph analysis spots a ripple of identities sharing funding or synchronized timing a falcon cluster and slashes every bond in it. An attacker minting N personas must post N bonds, and one detection burns them all, while reward per identity stays fixed. His cost grows linearly with N while payoff does not, so a large Sybil farm loses money.
